name: process-retrospective
description: Run gated evidence-based process retrospectives, compare telemetry windows when available, force a daily full review, and avoid unchanged reasoning turns.

INTERVAL_SECONDS.prompt: Default seconds between retrospective passes. Minimum one hour.

INITIAL_DELAY_SECONDS.prompt: Default delay before the first retrospective pass.

PASSES_PER_FOCUS.prompt: Number of passes before rotating to another analytical focus.

REVIEW_WINDOW_HOURS.prompt: Recent activity window considered by each retrospective.

GATE_ENABLED.prompt: Skip agent reasoning when bounded correction, failure, authentication-block, and regression signals are unchanged.

FORCE_REVIEW_SECONDS.prompt: Maximum seconds between full reasoned retrospectives even when no signal changes.

SIGNAL_LOOKBACK_LIMIT.prompt: Maximum recent artifacts and task outcomes inspected by the lightweight gate.
